messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Generic versions of rosuvastatin tablets may contain different inactive ingredients from those listed above.
Check the product label for your particular formulation for a complete list of ingredients.
Triplet: ["rosuvastatin", "has inactive ingredient", "microcrystalline cellulose NF"]

The relation 'has inactive ingredient' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug contains the inactive pharmaceutical ingredient specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
B. 'is salt form of': The subject drug is a salt form of the active pharmaceutical ingredient specified by the object entity.
C. 'releases medicine': The subject drug releases its active ingredient in the manner specified by the object entity.
D. 'reduced absorption by': The absorption of the subject drug is decreased due to the presence of the substance specified by the object entity.
E. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
